mapper.sql: id, tenant_id as tenantId, scm_archive_id as scmArchiveId, hospital_code as hospitalCode, scm_supplier_code as scmSupplierCode, spd_material_id as spdMaterialId, spd_supplier_id as spdSupplierId, material_name as materialName, pinyin_code as pinyinCode, specification, model, unit_name as unitName, price, sale_price as salePrice, register_no as registerNo, register_name as registerName, manufacturer_name as manufacturerName, udi_code as udiCode, medical_name as medicalName, medical_no as medicalNo, brand, payload_json as payloadJson, scm_update_time as scmUpdateTime, last_sync_batch_id as lastSyncBatchId, apply_status as applyStatus, last_apply_log_id as lastApplyLogId, del_flag as delFlag, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark
mapper.select: select from spd_scm_material_archive where id = #{id} and (del_flag is null or del_flag = '' or del_flag = '0') limit 1
select from spd_scm_material_archive where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and scm_archive_id = #{scmArchiveId} and (del_flag is null or del_flag = '' or del_flag = '0') limit 1

select from spd_scm_material_archive where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (del_flag is null or del_flag = '' or del_flag = '0')
and apply_status = #{applyStatus}
and ( material_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(pinyin_code,'') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(spd_material_id,'') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(scm_supplier_code,'') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(specification,'') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by scm_update_time desc, update_time desc, create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into spd_scm_material_archive( id, tenant_id, scm_archive_id, hospital_code, scm_supplier_code, spd_material_id, spd_supplier_id, material_name, pinyin_code, specification, model, unit_name, price, sale_price, register_no, register_name, manufacturer_name, udi_code, medical_name, medical_no, brand, payload_json, scm_update_time, last_sync_batch_id, apply_status, last_apply_log_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{scmArchiveId}, #{hospitalCode}, #{scmSupplierCode}, #{spdMaterialId}, #{spdSupplierId}, #{materialName}, #{pinyinCode}, #{specification}, #{model}, #{unitName}, #{price}, #{salePrice}, #{registerNo}, #{registerName}, #{manufacturerName}, #{udiCode}, #{medicalName}, #{medicalNo}, #{brand}, #{payloadJson}, #{scmUpdateTime}, #{lastSyncBatchId}, #{applyStatus}, #{lastApplyLogId}, '0', #{createBy}, now(), #{remark} )
mapper.select:
select m.id as materialId, m.code as materialCode, m.name as materialName, m.speci as specification, m.model as model, m.price as price, m.sale_price as salePrice, m.supplier_id as supplierId, s.name as supplierName, b.scm_supplier_code as scmSupplierCode, m.referred_name as pinyinCode, m.register_no as registerNo, m.is_gz as isGz, m.is_billing as isBilling from fd_material m inner join spd_scm_supplier_bind b on b.tenant_id = m.tenant_id and b.supplier_id = concat('', m.supplier_id) and (b.del_flag is null or b.del_flag = '' or b.del_flag = '0') and b.scm_supplier_code is not null and trim(b.scm_supplier_code) != '' left join fd_supplier s on s.id = m.supplier_id and s.tenant_id = m.tenant_id where m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (m.del_flag = 0 or m.del_flag is null) and m.supplier_id is not null
and ( m.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(m.code,'') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(m.referred_name,'') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(m.speci,'') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(s.name,'') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by m.update_time desc, m.id desc limit 500
